children: NCS Multistage Holdings Inc. (NCSM) filed a Form 8K - Changes to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.
The information set forth under the Introductory Note and in Item 2.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated by reference into this Item 5.03.

Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, at the Effective Time the certificate of incorporation and the bylaws of the Company as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Time were each amended and restated in their entirety, as set forth in Exhibits 3.1 and 3.2, respectively, to this Current Report on Form 8-K, which are incorporated by reference into this Item 5.03.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1692427/000119312526377638/d534761d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1692427/000119312526377638/0001193125-26-377638-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
